The diet I feed them is a combination of the pellets, and a homemade, honey based ice cream like substance ( it is made with lots of honey, eggs, and a high protein powder especially designed for sugar gliders.) Then fresh foot and vegetables to snack on through the night. And some treats such as yogurt drops or bugs such as the dried mealworms I feed mine. Mine are really picky so they each have thier likes and dislikes of what they'll eat.

They are horrible pets, but they are very rewarding pets. Because you put so much work into them, they are that much more rewarding when you befriend them. And they are the most loyal and affectionate pet when they do finally bond to you. You can also train the like in the video with a clicker and treats, because of how smart they are.
